title: Red Velvet Cheesecake Dump Cake
ingredients: 1 (8 oz) block Philadelphia Cream Cheese, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 (14 oz) can Eagle Brand Sweetened Condensed Milk
1 (15.25 oz) box Betty Crocker Super Moist Red Velvet Cake Mix
3/4 cup (1.5 sticks) Land O'Lakes Butter, sliced thin
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Scatter the cubes of Philadelphia Cream Cheese evenly across the bottom of the prepared dish.
Pour the can of Eagle Brand Sweetened Condensed Milk completely over the cream cheese cubes.
Sprinkle the dry Betty Crocker Red Velvet Cake Mix evenly over the wet layer. Cover the entire surface with the thin slices of Land O'Lakes Butter. Bake for 40-45 minutes until the top is set.
notes: Recipe found directly in the reel caption (Chloe's Cake Closet).
